item.title: Iran holds conference to advance justice for EB patients
item.description: A conference titled A Strong Iran: Epic of Authority and Victory of Justice for Epidermolysis Bullosa Patients was held at the Imam Khomeini Judicial Complex on October 25, 2026, attended by the Tehran Province chief justice, Judiciary spokesperson, head of the EB Patients’ House, a lawyer representing the patients, and around 50 patients and their family members.

item.title: Iran ready to deliver response beyond enemy’s expectations: Speaker Ghalibaf
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran is prepared to deliver a response beyond its adversaries’ imagination to any attack on its territorial integrity, Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said, adding that threats of a wider war or assassination would not force the Iranian nation to abandon its rights and interests.

Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86302709/Iran-ready-to-deliver-response-beyond-enemy-s-expectations-Speaker

Tehran, IRNA – Iran is prepared to deliver a response beyond its adversaries’ imagination to any attack on its territorial integrity, Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said, adding that threats of a wider war or assassination would not force the Iranian nation to abandon its rights and interests.
